title: Can Occupational Therapy help my child deal with hair brushing and teeth brushing?
metaTitle: Occupational Therapy for Hair and Teeth Brushing Skills - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn how the occupational therapists at Pinnacle Blooms Network work with kids to help them overcome difficulties with important self-care activities like brushing hair and teeth.
html: Yes, indeed! Pinnacle Blooms Network's dedicated team of occupational therapists can certainly assist your child overcome the discomfort related to brushing hair and teeth. We target any tactile sensitivities and hand-eye coordination issues, using specialized techniques aimed at gradually making these essential personal hygiene tasks a part of their standard routine. Our goal is to support your child in becoming more independent and confident in self-care.
